hero.title: EduArabic.
hero.subtitle: Learn Arabic. Speak it with confidence.
hero.description: EduArabic brings interactive modules, free audio, live classes with an ustaz, and an AI Ustaz that corrects your Arabic — all in one connected place to learn, at any level.

features.title: See EduArabic in action
features.description: A connected learning flow: watch short clips, master grammar & morphology, listen to podcasts, practise with AI Ustaz, and join live classes — everything in sync.
features.step1_desc: 2–3 minute videos per concept — watch, repeat and master without feeling overwhelmed.
features.step2_desc: Every rule broken into small steps with real Arabic example sentences and translations.
features.step3_desc: A node path — clips, exercises, podcasts — unlocked one by one as you earn XP.
features.step4_desc: Spaced-repetition questions keep new Arabic vocabulary locked into memory.
features.step5_desc: Listen to podcasts & tajweed recitation — on the go, at home, at no cost.
features.step6_desc: Write an Arabic sentence and AI Ustaz fixes grammar & spelling with examples.
features.step7_desc: Join Zoom/Meet sessions by plan — a clean schedule, one-tap to join.
features.step8_desc: Daily streaks, badges and module certificates to keep your momentum up.
features.step9_desc: See completed units, XP, and your suggested next step on one dashboard.
